s: Single typed endpoint where clients shape responses - composed from many services via federated schemas.
w: Clients send queries describing exact fields needed; gateway resolves each field via resolvers (local or federated entity calls), batches/dedupes upstream fetches, returns merged JSON. Federation lets teams own subgraphs composing one supergraph. Complexity analysis/depth limits guard abusive queries; persisted-query allowlists harden production.
use: Frontend teams iterating UI fast without backend endpoint churn
Aggregating many BFFs into one graph (mobile especially benefits)
Public developer platforms offering flexible querying (GitHub API v4)
avoid: Simple CRUD with stable shapes (REST simpler ops)
Teams unable to enforce query-cost limits (DoS surface)

pat.d: The graph IS the ultimate BFF - one schema per experience domain.

pits: Resolver N+1 storms - DataLoader-style batching/caching mandatory
Query-depth DoS - cost analysis + depth limits + persisted queries
tips: Overfetch/underfetch vocabulary + federation governance story covers most questions
